items.title: Define evidence activation policy and threshold contract
items.context: Specify the exact eligibility contract for evidence-activated advisory playbooks: candidate status, recommend_activate decision, decisiveSamples denominator, helped/dismissed/harmful thresholds, concrete exposureMode, structured verdictSource, source_lineage_audit no-blocker posture, digest binding, idempotency, and demotion/rollback semantics. Explicitly state that story DONE alone is never activation evidence.
items.userSees: playbook_auto_promotion_apply --dryRun --json lists eligible and blocked candidates with concrete blocker reasons instead of asking the user to manually choose from hundreds of experiences.
excludes: using DONE success as helped evidence
turning playbooks into lifecycle gate evidence

happy.desc: A candidate with recommend_activate, sufficient decisive helped samples, valid exposure, structured verdict source, clean lineage, and matching digest is reported eligible for activation.

edge.desc: Neutral/unknown outcomes and DONE settlement rows are excluded from decisive promotion denominators and cannot make a candidate eligible.

adversarial.desc: A stale digest, duplicate lineage source, missing exposure, missing reviewed policy, or harmful outcome blocks activation with a precise reason.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke proves a candidate with applied recommend_activate, decisive helped samples, concrete exposure, structured reviewer verdict, clean lineage, and current digest is eligible and activated.
Smoke keeps DONE settlement/neutral rows out of helped evidence and decisive activation denominators.
Smoke proves missing real outcome evidence fails closed and duplicate/missing lineage blockers from the seed loop remain enforced.

items.title: Implement guarded evidence activation writer
items.context: Turn playbook_auto_promotion_apply from guard-only into a real evidence activation writer. The writer should activate only evidence-eligible advisory candidates when an explicit reviewed activation policy and qualifying evidence are present. It must append audit records, remain non-authoritative, never satisfy gates, and be idempotent over candidate digest and decision digest. Do not require a global default-off environment flag just to make the CLI usable.
items.userSees: lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json activates only evidence-eligible candidates and reports activated, skipped, and blocked counts; missing evidence or missing reviewed policy blocks with precise reasons.
excludes: activating candidates without a reviewed activation policy
requiring an always-off environment flag for ordinary CLI use

happy.desc: With reviewed policy, matching digest, clean lineage, and qualifying outcome evidence, --apply activates the candidate and records an audit row without requiring an always-off environment flag.

edge.desc: Re-running --apply is idempotent and does not duplicate activation or audit rows.

adversarial.desc: Without reviewed policy, clean lineage, qualifying outcomes, or current digest, --apply fails closed and writes nothing.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke proves --apply activates an evidence-qualified candidate and writes one non-authoritative activation audit row without PLAYBOOK_AUTO_ACTIVE_ENABLED.
Smoke reruns --apply after activation and proves activatedCount is 0 with exactly one activation audit row.
Smoke proves no-evidence apply fails closed and leaves playbooks non-active; activation audit binds applied decision id/idempotency/digest.

items.title: Add demotion and rollback safety for evidence-activated playbooks
items.context: Provide a bounded rollback path so automatic advisory activation is reversible when later outcomes show harmful, dismissed, stale, or noisy behavior. This can be a demote recommendation consumed by activation status or an explicit demotion command if the existing playbook lifecycle lacks one.
items.userSees: playbook_promotion_status --json shows automatically activated playbooks, their evidence basis, and any demotion/rollback recommendation when later evidence becomes negative.
excludes: blocking story DONE based on playbook quality
changing active runtime guidance without audit trail

happy.desc: A later harmful or dismissed evidence profile produces a demotion/rollback recommendation for an auto-activated advisory playbook.

edge.desc: Manual active playbooks and auto-activated playbooks retain distinct audit provenance.

adversarial.desc: Rollback/demotion cannot erase original candidate, activation, or outcome evidence.

items.title: Prove activation is evidence-driven, not human-blame-driven
items.context: Add a smoke that demonstrates the full local path: seed/proposal/candidate, explicit exposure/outcome, promotion sweep recommend_activate, source lineage check, auto-promotion dry-run eligibility, guarded apply activation, runtime consumption verify, and demotion blocker. Include negative fixtures proving story DONE, human memory alone, and missing policy/evidence do not activate anything.
items.userSees: The test transcript shows activation happens from evidence thresholds and digest bindings, not from a human manually accepting blame for each candidate.

happy.desc: End-to-end fixture proves evidence-qualified candidate becomes active under reviewed activation policy and qualifying evidence.

edge.desc: A large batch with mixed eligible/ineligible candidates activates only the eligible subset and reports skipped reasons.

adversarial.desc: Story DONE, stale recommendation, duplicate source lineage, missing policy, or missing exposure cannot activate a candidate.

auditLog.reason: Policy and threshold contract implemented and proven by B-7ee1 smoke.
Evidence activation writer implemented, committed by implementer, and verified.
